name: Grünwalderhof
beschreibung:
Situated on a sunny scenic plateau above Innsbruck, the historic Gruenwalderhof features refined rooms, timeless heritage, and outstanding Tyrolean gastronomy facing Mount Serles.

The Patscherkofel cable car, panoramic hiking trails, and the city of Innsbruck are only minutes away.
kurzbeschreibung: The historic Gruenwalderhof in Patsch blends aristocratic tradition with panoramas of the Stubai Alps.
